Close to the Hebrew; the second “sought” is rendered “inquired of.”

Close to the Hebrew; “who thicken on their lees” is rendered “Who are settled in complacency,” and “I will visit” “punish.”

Close to the Hebrew; “the high corners” is rendered “the high towers.”
